dismissals.because: src/forge/nextstep.py:1 forge next has no discovery prompt yet; DISCOVER adds it, so the crossing test that orders the due check before discovery is written in DISCOVER's tests/test_discovery.py

findings.body: The explicitly required test crossing the due check and discovery prompt is missing. This assertion checks ordering only against generic idle output; it never exercises discovery, so it cannot detect discovery suppressing or preceding a due check. Add the required case exercising both outputs and asserting that the due check comes first.
findings.title: Not done: due-check precedence over discovery test
